analysis.time: Published on August 5, 2026; event assessment dated August 6, 2026. The Dutch man first showed symptoms on April 6, 2026, five days after boarding the MV Hondius in Ushuaia on April 1, 2026.
analysis.location_and_population: Ushuaia, Tierra del Fuego Province, Argentina; the Dutch couple (both aged 69) from the Netherlands; Tierra del Fuego epidemiology director Juan Petrina.
analysis.event: A Tierra del Fuego health official stated that the likelihood the Dutch man linked to a hantavirus outbreak on the MV Hondius cruise ship contracted the disease in Ushuaia is 'almost zero.' Authorities have not confirmed media reports that the couple visited a dump in Ushuaia where rodent exposure could have occurred.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: Two deaths reported (the Dutch couple). Incubation period analysis indicates infection in Ushuaia is unlikely; Andes strain of hantavirus, which can transmit person-to-person, has not been detected in Tierra del Fuego since 1996. No additional cases or exposures reported in the supplied evidence.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: Authorities are investigating incubation timelines and possible exposure sites; rodent testing planned. Uncertainty remains regarding the couple's activities in Ushuaia, including unverified reports of a dump visit. No confirmed local transmission of Andes strain in Tierra del Fuego since 1996.

analysis.brief_en: A senior health official in Ushuaia has dismissed the possibility that a Dutch honeymooner who died of hantavirus on a cruise ship contracted the virus in the southern Argentine port. Juan Petrina, epidemiology director for Tierra del Fuego, told reporters on August 6 that the man’s symptoms appeared five days after boarding the MV Hondius on April 1, a timeline inconsistent with infection in Ushuaia. The couple, both aged 69, spent 48 hours in the city before sailing. While media suggested they may have visited a local dump, authorities have not confirmed this. The Andes strain—capable of person-to-person spread—has not been detected in the province since 1996, and officials plan to test rodents to trace the source.
analysis.summary_en: A senior health official in Ushuaia has dismissed the possibility that a Dutch honeymooner who died of hantavirus on a cruise ship contracted the virus in the southern Argentine port. Juan Petrina, epidemiology director for Tierra del Fuego, told reporters on August 6 that the man’s symptoms appeared five days after boarding the MV Hondius on April 1, a timeline inconsistent with infection in Ushuaia. The couple, both aged 69, spent 48 hours in the city before sailing. While media suggested they may have visited a local dump, authorities have not confirmed this. The Andes strain—capable of person-to-person spread—has not been detected in the province since 1996, and officials plan to test rodents to trace the source.

news.source_body_en: A senior health official in Ushuaia has dismissed the possibility that a Dutch honeymooner who died of hantavirus on a cruise ship contracted the virus in the southern Argentine port. Juan Petrina, epidemiology director for Tierra del Fuego, told reporters on August 6 that the man’s symptoms appeared five days after boarding the MV Hondius on April 1, a timeline inconsistent with infection in Ushuaia. The couple, both aged 69, spent 48 hours in the city before sailing. While media suggested they may have visited a local dump, authorities have not confirmed this. The Andes strain—capable of person-to-person spread—has not been detected in the province since 1996, and officials plan to test rodents to trace the source.

news.content: 2026年08月07日 欧洲头条 登入 搜索 欧洲头条 新欧洲 · 在欧洲 · 为华人 首页 意大利 法国 西班牙 德国 华人 国内 国际 温州 福建 搜索新闻 最近搜索 快速浏览 意大利 法国 西班牙 德国 华人 国内 国际 温州 搜索新闻 × 输入新闻关键词 搜索 最近搜索 热门栏目 意大利 法国 西班牙 德国 华人 国内 国际 温州 您的位置 > 首页 > 法国 法国卫生部门通报输入性安第斯汉坦病毒病例,患者已在西班牙隔离 来源: huarenjie 发布时间: 2026-08-06 18:23 阅读: 249 预计阅读: 约 2 分钟 纠错与反馈 阅读设置 小 中 大 紧 松 ◐ 暖色 本文目录(0) 💬 评论 0 ❤ 点赞 🔖 收藏 ↗ 分享 法国卫生部于8月6日发布公告称,一名曾于今年7月在法国旅行的游客被确诊感染安第斯汉坦病毒(Hantavirus Andes)。患者目前已在西班牙接受隔离治疗,法国卫生部门正追踪其在法国期间的行程,并与欧洲各国展开协调。 据介绍,这名患者拥有法国和阿根廷双重国籍,目前与家人在西班牙隔离。法国国家参考中心(CNR)已于8月6日确认其感染的是安第斯毒株。卫生部表示,患者目前已无症状,相关医疗救治和流行病学调查工作正在进行。 法国卫生部还表示,由法国卫生总局、法国公共卫生署及多名科学专家组成的专家组已召开会议,评估这一输入性病例可能带来的风险,并研究后续应采取的防控措施。卫生部门预计将在稍后公布更多信息,同时已启动欧洲层面的协调机制。 与此前邮轮疫情无关联 法国卫生部门强调,目前没有任何证据表明该病例与今年春季发生在南极探险邮轮MV Hondius上的汉坦病毒疫情有关。今年4月,这艘从阿根廷出发的邮轮暴发安第斯汉坦病毒疫情,共造成3人死亡、至少13人感染。世界卫生组织已于今年7月宣布,该起疫情随着最后一名隔离人员解除隔离而正式结束。 什么是安第斯汉坦病毒? 汉坦病毒是一种较为罕见的病毒,目前没有疫苗,也没有针对性的特效治疗药物。全球每年都会报告数以万计的汉坦病毒感染病例,大多数患者都是因接触感染病毒的啮齿动物(如鼠类)的排泄物、尿液或唾液而感染。 不过,此次受到特别关注的是安第斯毒株(Andes virus)。这是目前已知唯一能够在人与人之间传播的汉坦病毒毒株,因此公共卫生部门对其保持高度警惕。 目前,法国卫生部门尚未报告新增关联病例,也未发现法国境内出现本地传播的迹象。由于患者已经没有症状,卫生部门正在重点追踪其旅行接触史,以确认是否存在潜在接触者。 来源:Actu 标签: 暂无标签 上一篇 休达地方政府说非法移民越境事件已致约百人死亡 下一篇 法国8岁男童遭“解压捏捏乐”爆裂灼伤,涉事玩具已下架调查 ❤️ 赞一个 (0) 🔗 分享 🔖 稍后阅读 用户评论 (0) 暂无评论,快来抢沙发吧!首评可提升互动曝光。 登录 后参与互动 分享 × ⌂ 首页 ◎ 关注 ↗ 热榜 ○ 我的 ↑顶部 应用状态 立即更新 知道了
